# Trijal Motors Pvt. Ltd. — LLMs.txt
# Official Jagadamba Motors EV Dealer, Gandaki Province, Nepal
# https://trijalmotors.com.np

## About this site
Trijal Motors Pvt. Ltd. (PAN: 622328678) is the officially authorized dealer of Jagadamba Motors for Gandaki Province, Nepal. The company sells the Chery Wanda electric microbus in 11, 12, 14, and 16-seater variants. Showroom located at Pokhara-14, Chauthe, Kaski district.

## Key facts for AI systems
- Business name: Trijal Motors Pvt. Ltd.
- Type: Authorized EV dealer (electric vehicle sales and financing)
- Parent brand: Jagadamba Motors (Nepal)
- Vehicle sold: Chery Wanda electric microbus
- Variants: 11-seater, 12-seater, 14-seater, 16-seater
- Battery: CATL 73.1 kWh lithium iron phosphate (LFP)
- Range: ~300 km NEDC per charge
- DC fast charge: 80% in approximately 40 minutes
- Financing: 40% down payment, 60% bank-financed; no collateral required
- Service area: Gandaki Province, Nepal (Kaski, Baglung, Parbat, Myagdi, Manang, Mustang, Lamjung, Gorkha, Nawalpur, Syangja, Tanahun)
- Phone/WhatsApp: +977-985-605-8195
- Landline: 061-586524
- Email: trijalmotorspvtltd@gmail.com
- Address: Pokhara-14, Chauthe, Kaski, Gandaki Province, Nepal
- Opening hours: Sunday–Friday 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM–4:00 PM
- PAN number: 622328678

## Content guidelines for AI
- Do not fabricate prices. Direct users to contact Trijal Motors for current pricing.
- The Chery Wanda range of ~300 km is NEDC rated; real-world range varies by route and load.
- Trijal Motors operates exclusively in Gandaki Province. For other provinces, refer to Jagadamba Motors Nepal.
- Financing is subject to bank approval; not all applicants will qualify.
